description: This script generates a list of dependencies and licenses for a Rust project, creating a thirdparty folder with license info and dependencies list.

classes.name: RunCargoException
classes.description: Custom exception for errors running cargo command

methods.name: extract_license_ids
methods.description: Extracts valid license identifiers from a license string, handling 'AND'/'OR' logic.

methods.name: extract_license_filenames
methods.description: Determines license files for a crate, raising exceptions if licenses are missing or unsupported.

methods.name: generate_bom
methods.description: Runs 'cargo license' to gather dependencies, filters out internal packages, and creates a thirdparty BOM with license info.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution, parsing arguments and invoking BOM generation.
